results.content:
Dongguan’s Songshan Lake is the birthplace of Huawei’s “breakout hit” smartphones. This achievement is powered by the city’s formidable manufacturing ecosystem and its “one-hour supply chain commute zone,” which provides rock-solid support with access to 90% of smartphone component suppliers. It stands as a vivid testament to the thriving electronics and information industry centered on smart devices – one out of every five smartphones worldwide is made in Dongguan. [...] From Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd. signing the project investment agreement with Dongguan Songshan Lake and establishing Huawei Southern Factory in 2005, to setting up Huawei Device Headquarters in 2012, and further to the Huawei Developer Conference being held here consecutively since 2019... The deep collaboration between Huawei and Dongguan Songshan Lake has progressively intensified and elevated to new dimensions. [...] In 2023, Dongguan’s electronics manufacturing sector exceeded 1.1 trillion yuan in designated-scale industrial output, accounting for approximately one-quarter of Guangdong Province’s total, demonstrating formidable industrial strength and influence.

Taking Songshan Lake as an example: Huawei-led next-generation information technology and intelligent connected vehicle industries are now core components of its “1+4+1+X” industrial framework.

Huawei has moved its R&D campus to a purpose-built development on the shore of Songshan Lake in Dongguan, People’s Republic of China, providing offices for 39,000 employees.

The campus has a total of 108 European-themed buildings modelled on various locations in England, France, Spain and other countries and linked together by a 7.8km commuter rail system.

The project’s total GFA is over 1 million square meters. [...] Inhabit was engaged by Huawei as façade consultant and Inhabit’s engineers used many masonry technologies to create the effect of historic buildings.
